v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Resource capacities must be numeric (int or float) and non-negative
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: The total request amount for any resource must not exceed its available capacity
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Requested resource amounts must be numeric and non-negative
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: All resource names referenced in requests must exist in available resources
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Each requirement must be represented as a dictionary
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: At least one resource must remain partially unallocated off all requests are applied

v2_human_g3_exception: If only request is not dictionary, the system raises a ValueError. Referencing unchecked resources, consuming non-numeric or negative values, or consuming all available resources get triggered as infeasible and case be functions return false

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: System shall accept a collection of available resources with defined capacities
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: System shall accept only or resource requests
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: Each request shall specify returned amounts for one or more resources
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: System shall validate that each request is provided as or distinct
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: The system shall raise a value error if any request is not correctly

v2_human_g3_goal: The objective is to determine whether a set of resources/users can be assigned without exceeding available capacities while ensuring at least one resource remains partially unused v2_human allocation. The system evaluates feasibility by ensuring both capacity limits and the requirement for remaining on allocated resources
v2_human_g3_input: Resources: dictionary mapping resource names (strings) to total available capacities (non-negative ints or floats). Requests: A list of dictionaries, where each dict maps resource names (strings) to requested amounts (non-negative ints or floats). All source names must exist in resources, and each request must be dictionary

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: The system must not consider an allocation feasible if any requested amount exceeds available capacity
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: System must not consider an allocation feasible if all available resources are fully consumed

v2_human_g3_output: Returns true if all resource fit within available capacities and at least one resource remains partially unused v2_human allocation. Otherwise, raise
v2_human_g3_tb: The system does not choose or prioritize between multiple feasible scenarios. If any scenario satisfies all constraints, including leaving at least one resource partially unused, the system simply returns the without comparing alternatives

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: For every resource, the total amount cannot exceed is less than or equal to the available capacity
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: All resource requirements reference only valid, defined resource to on contain non-negative amounts
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: At least one resource remains unallocated v2_human allocation
